answer: Challenge-bound work receipts. Each agent identity must return a signed computation over a fresh server challenge whose input derives from that agent's prior output chain, so answers cannot be copied between identities. A valid reply must land within a narrow horizon tied to the challenge issue time, blocking precomputation and replay. To forge a parallel identity, an attacker must independently run the full chain and produce a matching pulse of signed receipts; costs scale linearly per identity with no shared shortcut.
